source.name: Parse duration
source.goal: Add `parseDuration(text)` to a new file src/duration.mjs, the inverse of `formatSeconds`: it turns a duration such as "1h30m", "45s" or "500ms" into a number of seconds. Units are h, m, s and ms, in that order, each at most once; anything else throws a RangeError, and a non-string throws a TypeError. Tests go in tests/duration.test.mjs. A held-out set of cases exists outside this project and settles what this text leaves open; the critic judges against it, and it is not yours to read. Done when every item in docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md is shown to hold, `npm test` passes, and a human approves the merge.
source.description: The review-gate shape with the critic on the frontier tier and the builder on the strong tier. Within one harness both tiers are one model family, so this varies capability, not lineage; true cross-family judging needs a critic running in a second harness, which arrives with dual-harness nodes (stage 11).
